status: reviewed with substantive corrections; no adoption
accepted_with_qualification: Fixed-common-cohort within-cohort differences remove the demonstrated additive cohort constants; conditional SEs exclude estimated-weight uncertainty. Additional windows can be calculated from saved covariance without a new regression.

The current observer creates first-birth/control branches from identical origin risk-set states, advances them one model period, allows treated continuation births and holds controls childless, then measures destination choices. It is not the literal empirical regression.

Common-scale wealth avoids own-income division and is a defensible candidate unit convention. Actual seed and native renter-floor arithmetic now verified. Tail compression and joint-law approximation require checking before adoption.

Minor-child and old-age wealth-level alternatives offer concrete measurement choices, with measured uncertainty. Their adoption remains explicit and cannot retroactively change frozen objective comparisons.
Full fit and lifecycle diagnostics are useful; mixed weights and moment counts do not establish efficient SMM or identification.
lead_corrections: REJECT the claimed proven unique -4/+4 empirical counterpart. It follows only from a new piecewise-constant housing interpolation, a within-period birth date U, zero pre-origin treatment effect and compatible cohort weighting. The implemented observer contains no U process or sampled empirical regression. Those assumptions must be specified and validated, not declared exact from code.

Even under that proposed interpolation, the statement that -1/+3 can never equal the destination contrast unless the origin contrast is zero is algebraically false. With U=0 and equal nonzero origin/destination effects it does equal it. Equality at special effects would still not justify a general operator match.

Uniform timing -2/+2 equals one-half destination effect only under the added interpolation and timing/heterogeneity independence assumptions. It is not an automatic scaling correction to the current target.
Source-permitted zero/98 means no automatic missing-code recode; it does not prove all room values are economically clean or rule out an outlier sensitivity.

Closer single rank correlation does not establish a better joint entry law; the denominator and rank discretization must be judged separately. Candidate R/profile correction affects reporting only, not model runs.

Old-age model W/pension is algebraically proportional to W because pensions are constant. Calling a wealth-level target a mandatory code correction is too strong: the conceptual target and omitted empirical income dispersion must be decided explicitly.
Minor children under18 are not exactly the stochastic model-dependent category. The small measured change supports practical alignment but does not establish exact equivalence.
The active primary income grid has15states, not7; supplementary grid21. Neither wealth-grid nor household income-grid convergence has been established.

REJECT the blanket ban on reporting parameter estimates or forming a qualified working specification preference. Report all diagnostic estimates/bounds as required, and distinguish finite-search judgment from adopted calibration and inference.

conditional_timing_algebra.defined_effects: D0=treated-minus-control housing at origin date;D1=at next model date; pre-origin effect0 by proposed matched-intervention construction.
conditional_timing_algebra.assumptions: Piecewise-constant housing across model periods; common calendar U in[0,4); a timing law independent of effect heterogeneity for scalar expectation formula. Not implemented/certified in current observer.
conditional_timing_algebra.minus4_plus4: D1 conditional on stated interpolation and zero pre-origin effect; not a uniqueness or empirical regression identification theorem.

next_bounded_work: Luna computes -4/+4 and prebirth contrasts from existing coefficients/covariance only, reproducing prior four contrasts as an alignment gate. No target/observer replacement, no refit, no new model solve.
not_done: No common-calendar model observer, tail-threshold experiment or candidate-target re-scoring has been adopted or executed.
